description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the Diagnosis Data Access Object (DAO) using Hibernate for the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting Diagnosis entities and associated attribute types, handling database interactions with Hibernate ORM.

classes.name: HibernateDiagnosisDAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of the DiagnosisDAO interface, providing CRUD operations and query methods for Diagnosis entities within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Injects the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis
methods.description: Saves or updates a Diagnosis object in the database.

methods.name: getActiveDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided diagnoses for a patient, optionally filtered from a specific date.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific encounter, with options to filter by primary and confirmed status.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific visit, with filtering options similar to getDiagnosesByEncounter.

methods.name: getDiagnosisById
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis by its numerical ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis entity using its UUID.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Deletes a Diagnosis object from the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a DiagnosisAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a DiagnosisAttributeType using its UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttribute by its UUID.
